metadata.description: Same customer code as Control Plane: 2–8 lowercase letters/digits, start with a letter, only single internal hyphens.
Existing enterprise VNet resource ID. Leave empty to let bootstrap create the default reporting VNet.
Container Apps delegated subnet resource ID inside the existing VNet.
PostgreSQL delegated subnet resource ID inside the existing VNet.
Exactly the selected Control Plane modules; cloud permissions are bootstrapped only for cloud.
Must equal the tenant of the selected customer subscription.

Released agent image: registry/repository@sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>. Tags are rejected.

variables.validDigest: [and(and(equals(length(variables('imageParts')), 2), equals(length(variables('digest')), 64)), equals(length(filter(range(0, length(variables('digest'))), lambda('i', not(contains('0123456789abcdef', substring(variables('digest'), lambdaVariables('i'), 1)))))), 0))]
variables.validatedAgentImage: [if(and(variables('validDigest'), startsWith(parameters('agentImage'), format('{0}/', parameters('registryServer')))), parameters('agentImage'), fail('agentImage must use the registryServer and an immutable sha256 digest'))]
variables.validCustomerCode: [and(and(and(contains('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', first(parameters('customerCode'))), contains('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789', last(parameters('customerCode')))), not(contains(parameters('customerCode'), '--'))), equals(length(filter(range(0, length(parameters('customerCode'))), lambda('i', not(contains('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-', substring(parameters('customerCode'), lambdaVariables('i'), 1)))))), 0))]
variables.validatedCustomerCode: [if(variables('validCustomerCode'), parameters('customerCode'), fail('customerCode must start with a lowercase letter, end with a letter/digit and contain only lowercase letters/digits or single internal hyphens'))]
variables.boundCustomerCode: [if(and(equals(parameters('subscriptionId'), subscription().subscriptionId), equals(parameters('entraTenantId'), tenant().tenantId)), variables('validatedCustomerCode'), fail('Bootstrap tenant/subscription must match the selected Azure context'))]
variables.boundExistingVirtualNetworkResourceId: [if(variables('validExistingNetworkBinding'), parameters('existingVirtualNetworkResourceId'), fail('Existing network IDs must be same-subscription VNet/subnet resource IDs and must be supplied together'))]

properties.description: At least three failed onboarding executions in 30 minutes. Inspect the customer Log Analytics workspace.

variables.validatedExistingVirtualNetworkResourceI: [if(variables('validExistingNetworkIds'), parameters('existingVirtualNetworkResourceId'), fail('Existing subnet resource IDs must be children of the supplied VNet resource ID'))]
